items.author: Joel Rush
items.body_excerpt:
In this age of a new generation of superstars - Wemby, Jokic, Luka, Shai, Brunson, etc - it's absolutely amazing that the NBA is "scoring" so many own goals on itself.

What might be one of the league's greatest eras is getting tainted by the rot of corruption, and it's just sad.
